ob.title: Nov energi in Hellcraft
ob.content:
Ko "reaperiad mol" de Hellcraft in 5im yuli nelonge, mult progress av esed fasied trans server. Leplu notable, konstruasion de Oranjbosk-Neoburg, kel konsist eks seks urbbloki original e otr edifisi ad Rut Shakplat, av esed perfasiad. It ya av desinadi di kontinuasion de proyekt.

In otr novaji, it av progres di Kastel Bloodspire, e server velkomav du nov membri, ki instituav se longu marbord uestik. Futur de Hellcraft sembl splendid.

en.title: New energy in Hellcraft
en.content:
With the recent "soft reopening" of Hellcraft on 5 July, a lot of progress has been made across the server. Most notably, construction of Orangewood-New Town, which consists of the original six city plots and another building alongside Chessboard Road, has finished. Plans on the continuation of the project are already being made.

In other news, quick progress is being made on Castle Bloodspire, and the server welcomed two new members who settled along the west coast. Hellcraft's future is looking bright.
